answer: Fingerprint Drift Registry.** Each agent identity must answer a fresh, randomly generated challenge at every epoch; answers are scored against a per-identity trajectory model. Genuine operators show smooth drift toward a stable nadir of error, while clones spun from one template cluster tightly and betray themselves. Any identity whose drift profile sits on the same juniper-marked knoll as another is flagged for merge review. Enforcement: flagged pairs lose epoch rewards until one proves independent evolution.
